about: Hero abilities adapted for climbing. deadlock_* columns are read from the player's scripts/abilities.vdata at runtime (value here = fallback, from SteamDB's tracked copy); climb_* columns are this mashup's tuning.

rows.climb_behaviour: Raycast from camera up to deadlock_range_m; on hitting level geometry, reel Bebop toward the hit point at climb_speed_mps, ignoring gravity, until within climb_release_m; keep 40% of velocity on release. Miss = short cooldown.
rows.source: abilities.vdata citadel_ability_hook: AbilityCastRange 30m, AbilityCooldown 23.0, m_strHookSuccessSound Bebop.Hook.Player

rows.climb_behaviour: Bebop uppercuts the air and launches himself: set vertical velocity to climb_speed_mps (keeps horizontal). Usable on ground or in air once per cooldown.
rows.source: abilities.vdata citadel_ability_uppercut: MeleeAttackLength 6m, AbilityCooldown 22.0, EnemyHeroTossVelocity 20m, m_strAbilityImage bebop_uppercut.psd
